craft_notes: CLOSING VERSE (thirteen sealed; the v3 iti-frame closed). Sthāyin: return-joy (she re-enters). Sanskrit first: preparation (mind held), return (goddess enters again), proclamation (return told, thirteen full) → L4 sets preparation+return line 1, proclamation line 2. Rows: row 1 (more-last — 'no more' closes as trayodaśa closes the count: nothing beyond). Rupture: dash after 'more' — entering done, telling begins. Close: end-weight on fullness ('no more' — the count complete, the song complete). Minimal pass: 'once more' for punar (again as once-more, singable); 'full score' refused for 'no more' (score imports games). Read aloud: line 1 holds (hold/enters/more), dash, line 2 seals (told/thirteen/more falling to rest). Rejected: 'thirteen in all' flat — killed: 'no more' closes the door Sanskrit closes; exclamation 'thirteen!' — killed: shouting un-Sanskrit, period seals.

lines: Hold the mind there — and she enters, goddess, once more:
then the return is told — thirteen, and no more.
l4.sanskrit_cite: cittaṃ tatra tu saṃdhārya punardaivī viśettu sā / tadā tv āgamanaṃ proktamevaṃ samyak trayodaśa

reads_against.argmap: Mind held there, the goddess re-enters — that return, fully thirteen, closes the doctrine.
c1_essence: Become Śiva, the self turns — the turning; nectar rained as creature-life; goddess re-enters — thirteen full.
